finding.source_observation: trigger2_generation_provenance_gate_v1 resolves TRIGGER2_TRUSTED_SYNTHETIC_GENERATOR_AUTHORITY_V1.json from a repository path, verifies the authority-selected generator source_sha256, reconstructs subjects and recomputes XENO_SYNTHETIC_GENERATION_RECEIPT/v1. The receipt binds generator identity, invocation parameter/material digests, subject digests, semantic scope and zero-credit fences. At exact current source identity it does not include the authority manifest's own blob identity or JCS/SHA-256 digest.

hypothesis: An admitted row or historical replay object that carries only XENO_SYNTHETIC_GENERATION_RECEIPT/v1 can become authority-time-dependent if the authority manifest later changes while retaining the same path/schema, because the receipt itself does not identify the exact authority-manifest bytes that authorized the case/subjects.
counterhypothesis: Row-level authority-manifest identity is redundant because every dataset admission and later replay is always wrapped by a mandatory exact repository HEAD/tree/source-hash receipt that preserves the historical authority bytes.
resolution_rule: Do not choose between these by convenience. If downstream dataset admission/replay provably requires and verifies an immutable outer HEAD/tree envelope that includes the authority manifest, document that as the replay root. Otherwise bind authority_manifest_sha256_or_blob_identity into the generation receipt and invocation identity.

cheapest_high_information_discriminator.mutation: Replace the trusted generation-authority manifest with a schema-valid successor that changes an allowed case/subject authority and coherently regenerate candidate subjects/receipt under the new manifest while retaining the same authority path.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.required_result: Historical receipt verification must reject unless the exact historical authority-manifest identity is independently bound by the receipt or by a mandatory verified outer exact-head/tree replay envelope.

artifact_lifecycle_delta.reason: Generator executable bytes are pinned, but authority-manifest bytes are not represented inside XENO_SYNTHETIC_GENERATION_RECEIPT/v1.
No claim that its content is wrong; the issue is exact historical identity binding at replay.
Recent policy-digest/source-lineage hardening concerns the A02 discriminator producer. A03 is an upstream generation-authority replay-root question.
V18 does not explicitly classify the generation-authority manifest replay-root question.

training_generation_decision.reason: A02 exact-current repository-bound execution remains unobserved and A03 replay-root identity is unresolved. More row volume would not increase trustworthy training readiness.

next_exact_action: First execute the exact-current A02 mutation/v4 suite on the admitted zero-cost repository-bound surface. Separately run T2_A03_AUTHORITY_DRIFT_MUTATION or prove the mandatory downstream outer exact-head/tree replay envelope before treating generation provenance as durable across authority evolution.
